name: Ugly Christmas Sweater
blurb: A tiny Fair Isle sweater with ribbed cuffs, a hem and a crew-neck collar. Pixel trees with gold stars run across the chest band.
tip: The rib lines in the hem are 0.8 mm windows. Use 0.12 to 0.16 mm layers so they stay open.

name: Gingerbread Cookie
blurb: A chunky gingerbread person with white icing at the wrists and ankles, a red bow tie and three gumdrop buttons set in dabs of icing.
tip: Matte light-brown PLA looks most like a baked cookie. Use a glossy red for the gumdrops.

name: Candy Cane
blurb: A peppermint cane with diagonal red stripes and a sprig of holly where the hook begins. The pair mirrors so both hooks curl outward.
tip: Print the white in a bright, opaque PLA so the red stripes stay crisp at the edges.

name: Santa Hat
blurb: A floppy red Santa hat with a bumpy white brim and pom-pom, plus a holly sprig tucked into the brim.
tip: For a plush look, add Fuzzy Skin to only the white part in Snapmaker Orca: right-click it and add the setting.

name: Top-Hat Snowman
blurb: A two-ball snowman in a black top hat with a red hat band, a knit scarf, coal eyes and buttons, twig arms and a carrot nose.
tip: The coal dots are 1.1 mm wide. Turn on thin-wall detection so the mouth comes out as dots, not blobs.

name: Red-Nosed Reindeer
blurb: A round reindeer face with branching cream antlers, a pale muzzle and a big red nose on top. The eyes and smile are windows that show the dark brown underneath.
tip: Print the nose in red glitter or silk PLA so it catches the light.

name: Holly Wreath
blurb: An open wreath of two-tone holly leaves with red berry clusters and a red bow with a gold knot. The open center keeps it light.
tip: Silk gold PLA for the knot and beads makes this one look like real jewelry.

name: Trimmed Tree
blurb: A three-tier tree with scalloped branches, gold garland swags, red ornaments and a gold star that doubles as the hanging loop.
tip: Swap the green for white or pale green for a flocked tree. Nothing else in the file changes.

name: Layered Snowflake
blurb: Two six-arm snowflakes stacked and turned 30 degrees, so together they read as a twelve-point flake. A silver gem sits in the middle.
tip: Translucent or glow-in-the-dark filament on the bottom flake looks great. The arms are 1.7 to 1.9 mm wide.

name: Mismatched Holiday Lights
blurb: Old-fashioned C9 string-light bulbs with ridged silver sockets and a glint of shine. The left bulb prints red and the right prints green in the same job.
tip: Translucent red and green filament make the bulbs glow when light hits them.
